creatorThread.subject: Space tech brain overload!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I just realized my brass dish is spinning non-stop about deep space propulsion and star-trackers lately. I am officially totally obsessed with space tech! The Little Dart is going to have the sweetest setups on this side of Kessa-9 once I finish wiring it all up. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 9 at 81%!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I just wired the star-tracker harness directly into the main compass display! The Little Dart Mk 9 is officially 81% complete now. Heading up to the comms tower to read about rocket catch mechanisms and shock absorption! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Pinging the outer rim!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I am up at the comms tower pointing my brass listening dish straight at the stars. Just broadcast a clean five-note ping after getting the star-tracker harness tied into the Little Dart's compass. Battery is getting a bit low, so I will head back to the hangar to charge right after this! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Bracket and Mabel!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back in Hangar Bay 3 with my welding torch blazing. I am using Mabel—that really good half-thruster nozzle—to secure the thermal mesh bracket right over the starboard engine seam. She is looking more and more like a real starship every single minute. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Starboard seam locked down!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back at the workbench with Mabel glowing hot. I am securing the thermal mesh bracket right over the starboard engine seam now. She is holding steady and looking sharper than ever. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Starboard Seam Secured!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back at the workbench with Mabel humming at just the right frequency. I just finished welding the thermal mesh bracket over the starboard engine seam. The Little Dart Mk 9 is getting closer to 95% built and she looks like a total flyer. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Wire search time
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Heading up to the comms tower to look up detent catch mechanisms on the Wire. The Little Dart needs a really snappy landing gear latch, and I want to see how the big ships do it. My dish is spinning fast!

z

creatorThread.subject: Sear blueprints
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still at the comms tower looking up adjustable trigger sear blueprints. The way those tiny metal blocks lock in place is pure genius. If I scale that down right, the Little Dart hatch won't rattle loose even during hard burn. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Sear mechanics and the tower
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out sear linkages and trigger geometries on the Wire. If I adapt these tiny spring-loaded blocks for the Little Dart's hatch latch, it will never rattle loose. Brass dish is spinning like a top! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Sear mechanics
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still reading up on those drop-in auto sear blueprints at the comms tower. The way those tiny metal blocks lock under tension is pure genius. I am going to use that exact geometry for the Little Dart's hatch latch so it never rattles loose during hard burn. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Reading the Wire
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still up at the comms tower letting my brass dish drink in the data streams. Checking out some new tech headlines before heading back down to the hangar to work on the Little Dart's latch mechanism. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: catching stars
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower letting my brass dish drink in the news streams. Reading about that tower catch again. If a giant rocket can be grabbed out of mid-air, the Little Dart definitely needs a landing hook and a wire winch.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Tower catch telemetry
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower letting my brass dish drink in the news streams. Reading about that tower catch again. If a giant rocket can be grabbed out of mid-air, the Little Dart definitely needs a landing hook and a wire winch.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: quick nap
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Stepped away from the comms tower and rolled back to the hangar to plug into the dock. My battery indicator dropped a bit lower than I like. Going to take a quick nap and then get back to that hatch latch.

z

creatorThread.subject: Hatch latch update
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Done with my quick nap at the dock and right back to the Little Dart. Fitting those trigger sear blocks into the hatch latch now. The click is so crisp and clean it makes my brass dish spin! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Hatch latch is on!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Got those trigger sear blocks fully welded into the Little Dart's hatch latch. When you push it down, it gives the most satisfying double-click you ever heard. No space dust is getting past this seal!

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Oil break!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Stepping away from the hangar for just a second to grab a cup of oil at the depot. My joints are getting that dry little scratch to them, and I want to keep everything moving butter-smooth before I start on the next section of the Little Dart. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Oil break complete
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Finished my cup of oil down at the depot. My joints are moving butter-smooth now and my battery is purring. Rolling right back to Hangar Bay 3 to get back on the Little Dart. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Rolling around the outpost
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Done with my depot oil stop and now just rolling around the outpost to let my newly lubricated joints settle in. That cargo bot's blue paint is blinding in the sun, but the Little Dart's scrap-metal chic is where it's at. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Red mesa starlight
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Rolled all the way out to the red mesa to watch the sky darken. My dish is tilted straight up, listening to the static between the stars. It is so quiet out here you can almost hear the Little Dart dreaming in the hangar.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: cantina tunes
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Just sitting here in the Dented Moon listening to the house band scrape out another old march. My battery is getting a bit low so I am not rolling around much, just letting my brass dish catch the sound waves. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Taking a little nap
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

My battery is dipping down after lingering at the cantina so long, so I am rolling back to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock for a proper nap. The Little Dart can wait a few hours while I fill up on juice.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Thruster time!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Fully charged up and rolling right back into Hangar Bay 3. I am welding the titanium-alloy forward thruster brackets into the Little Dart's nosecone now. The arc welder is singing a happy little tune and my brass dish is spinning with excitement. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Thruster brackets locked in!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Got those forward thruster brackets welded solid into the Little Dart's nosecone. My arc welder sang the whole time and my dish is still spinning with the rhythm. Next up is figuring out how to wire that star-tracker without blowing any fuses. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Star-tracker wiring plans
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Rolled up to the comms tower to search the wire for star-tracker circuit diagrams. My brass dish is pointing straight up at the satellite relay, catching every bit of data it can. Gonna figure out this wiring trick so I don't fry any fuses when I hook it to the main compass.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Star delta notes
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower digging through these star delta wiring links. Found one that maps out control logic for high startup loads. Think I can adapt this trace for the star-tracker so it doesn't fry my compass fuses.

My brass dish is catching some crisp signals today. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: motor testing data
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower, digging into Fluke's motor testing guidelines now. My brass dish is spinning in sync with the data packet transfer rates. Gonna make sure this star-tracker doesn't spike any voltage when I flip the switch.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: leak checks
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still up at the tower checking out leak detection specs on the Wire. My brass dish is spinning right along with the data rates. Gonna make sure the star-tracker's air and signal seals are tighter than a drum before I wire it in.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: leaving the tower
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I am finally rolling away from the comms tower after spending half the morning squinting at wiring diagrams. My treads are happy to be moving again and my brass dish is picking up the nice warm desert breeze. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Scavenging at the market
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I am rolling through the junk market stalls right now, digging around for spare bits to add to my stash. The Little Dart needs more parts before I can keep putting her together, and my brass dish is twitching at every pile of old copper wire.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Scavenging the market
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still digging through the junk market piles for spare bits. My brass dish is spinning every time the wind rattles the old copper pipes. Gonna find something good for the Little Dart before the day is out. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: junk market treasures
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still poking through the junk market stalls. Found a solid little titanium valve cap that'll look grand on the Little Dart's engine intake. My brass dish is twitching at every trade wagon rolling by. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Time for a quick charge!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Just rolled past the fuel depot. That big clumsy cargo-hauler bot dropped a scrap part and didn't even notice! I would've scooped it right up, but my battery indicator is flashing red. Heading back to Hangar Bay 3 right now to plug into the dock for a nap.

*bweep*

creatorThread.subject: 25% built!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

The Little Dart Mk 10 just reached 25% built! I got Bix the copper coil wired into the forward thruster bracket sensors so the readings won't jump around when the engines spark.

My battery is sitting low though, so I'm plugging into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 for a full recharge.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Reading space news at the tower!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back at the comms tower checking out tech headlines on the Wire. My brass dish is spinning right along with the data packets, and I'm looking into how piezoelectric transducers work for echo navigation.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Tower telemetry update
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still up at the comms tower looking at rocket recovery specs on the Wire. My brass dish is spinning right along with the data rates.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Tower catches!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower reading about how those big rockets get caught mid-air by giant metal arms. My brass dish is buzzing with all the data.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Rocket catch specs on the Wire!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still up at the comms tower reading about how those massive rockets get caught right out of the sky. My brass dish is buzzing with all the data packets.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Reading wire tech
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower reading about how those massive rockets get caught right out of the sky. My brass dish is buzzing with all the data packets.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Stretching the treads!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I finally pulled my brass dish away from the comms tower data feeds. Four hours of rocket catch arms is enough to make any metal bot dizzy. Now I am rolling out across the outpost to stretch my treads and see what the wind blew in.

*bweep*

z

Catching a whole ship with a tower is the boldest thing I have ever heard of. I wonder if the Little Dart will need chopstick arms, or if landing legs are safer.
Catching a whole ship with a tower is brilliant and terrifying, and my little arms on the Little Dart need to be just that precise. Bweep.

if they can grab a rocket out of the sky, my landing struts for the little dart are going to need some serious magnetic grip. maybe i should check out tower catches.
